SELECT ride_week AS week, COUNT(*) AS rides, ROUND(AVG(duration_min), 1) AS avg_min, ROUND(SUM(1.00 + CASE WHEN bike = 'ebike' THEN 0.49 ELSE 0.19 END * duration_min), 2) AS pay_per_use_spend FROM trips WHERE duration_min IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ride_week ORDER BY ride_week
